title: Fix a MyApps remote launch browser error
issue: Fix a MyApps remote launch browser error
resolution_html:
1. Close other browser sessions using HR Self-Serve or SIS Web Apps
  2. Sign out of MyApps and close the browser
  3. Clear cookies for the affected session, then open a fresh browser window
  4. Sign back in to MyApps and launch the application again

These steps address the documented browser-session conflict, not every possible MyApps error
